customManagers.description: Update cloudflared image tag and digest
Update pinned tool versions in obolup.sh

Update Helm chart versions pinned as Go constants under a `// renovate: datasource=helm ...` annotation: remote-signer (internal/agentruntime/charts.go), bedag/raw (internal/hermes/hermes.go). datasource is constrained to helm so the hermes-agent image annotation in hermes.go is left to the image manager below.

Update the rancher/k3s image tag in the k3d config. Uses the docker datasource (the image tag `v1.35.9-k3s1` differs from the GitHub release `v1.35.9+k3s1`, so github-releases could never round-trip); the versioning regex skips -rcN tags.

Track ghcr.io/obolnetwork/* image pins in embedded infra templates. Captures both `image: <ref>:<tag>` and `image: <ref>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>` shapes, plus the pure-digest `image: <ref>@sha256:<digest>` form used historically. Renovate uses the docker datasource to discover newer tags and (with pinDigests) keeps the @sha256 part in lockstep. For this to drive useful tag bumps, release CI should tag images with sortable versions (e.g. v0.9.0-rc10) rather than only short commit SHAs — loose versioning can't decide which arbitrary SHA is newer.

Track the Hermes agent Docker image tag pinned in Go constants. Both the master agent (internal/hermes/hermes.go) and CRD sub-agents (internal/serviceoffercontroller/agent_render.go) read from a `nousresearch/hermes-agent:vYYYY.M.P` const that lacks a clean version-only field, so this regex captures the version suffix after the last colon as `currentValue`. The annotation form mirrors the Go-constant Helm chart manager above.

Track Ethereum/Aztec client image tags pinned in network helmfiles. Uses the `# renovate: datasource=X depName=Y` annotation immediately above each `tag:` line so the same regex handles every form we use (`v1.2.3`, `"1.2.3"`, `multiarch-v1.2.3`, plain `4.3.0`).

Track the @scalar/api-reference bundle version pinned in scalar_html.go (the /api docs renderer served over the public tunnel). Uses the `// renovate: datasource=npm depName=@scalar/api-reference` annotation immediately above the const. NOTE: the SRI hash next to it must be re-derived on every bump (Renovate can't compute it) — run scripts/update-scalar-sri.sh on the renovate branch before merging, or the browser blocks the script and /api renders blank.
Track Helm chart versions pinned in network helmfiles. Uses the `# renovate: datasource=helm depName=X registryUrl=Y` annotation immediately above each `version:` line in a release block.

packageRules.description: Group Hermes agent image updates. Both Go constants (master agent and CRD sub-agent default) move together: the controller and the host CLI must run against the same upstream contract. A major bump on Hermes should also re-run the agent-contract release-smoke flow (flow-16-sell-agent.sh, which asserts the bundled-skills contract) before merge, since the `.no-bundled-skills` marker semantics changed across v2026.5.28 → v2026.6.5 and could regress in a future release.

packageRules.description: Group LiteLLM updates
Group cloudflared updates
Batch obolup.sh tool version updates into a single PR
Group k3s image updates

Group ghcr.io/obolnetwork/* image bumps (verifier, controller, buyer, demo-server, public-storefront, etc.) and ensure they are digest-pinned. The custom regex manager above captures the tag and optional @sha256 suffix; pinDigests=true causes Renovate to add a digest to any pure-tag pin and keep it fresh.

Batch every Ethereum execution/consensus client tag and the ethereum-node chart pin into a single standing PR. The helmfile pins every supported EL+CL client (only one is selected per install via --execution-client / --consensus-client), but they all live in the same template, so it's simplest to bump them together. One PR, not ten.

Batch the obol/aztec-node chart pin and the aztecprotocol/aztec image tag into a single standing PR. Aztec testnet upgrades require the image and chart appVersion to stay aligned, so they should land together.

Never pick per-arch image tags (`-arm64`/`-amd64` suffixes). The Aztec repo publishes them next to the multi-arch tag; semver/loose versioning treats the suffix as a prerelease or a newer version (see the bogus aztec `503d…-arm64` proposal).
Aztec image tags are plain semver releases; anything else (commit-SHA tags) is not a version.
Group Go module minor/patch updates into one PR (go mod tidy runs via postUpdateOptions). Majors stay separate.
Keep k8s.io client libraries and controller-tools in lockstep.
Go toolchain: the go.mod `go` directive and golang builder images move together.
Dockerfile base images (distroless runtime).

Embedded infrastructure Helm charts (Traefik, kube-prometheus-stack, reloader, eRPC, obol-app). Majors need CRD + values review (Traefik 40.2+ stops bundling Gateway API CRDs; KPS majors need manual CRD applies on existing clusters), so they require dashboard approval.

The built-in helmfile manager's default file pattern also matches the Go-templated network helmfiles, whose chart/image pins are already tracked by the annotated regex managers. Disable it there to avoid duplicate PRs.
k3s minor bumps change the Kubernetes minor (and obolup's kubectl must stay within +/-1 minor of it), so minor/major k3s and kubectl updates need dashboard approval and should land together.
Front-end (web/frontend) npm dependencies — replaces the old obol-stack-front-end repo's dependabot npm updates. Minor/patch grouped weekly; majors separate.
